title: CoPaw-Flash-9B: Autonomous Data Analyst Agent
summary: A specialized agentic model based on the Qwen3.5-9B architecture, fine-tuned specifically for autonomous data science workflows using agent trajectory data. It independently handles the full analysis lifecycle, including data cleaning, statistical profiling, and generating visualizations via Python.
research_notes: Developed by Alibaba's AgentScope team; achieves optimal performance when paired with specific LoRA adapters and the vLLM execution environment.

evolution.summary: Evolved from basic tool-calling LLMs into a fully autonomous 'agentic' framework within the QwenPaw ecosystem, capable of multi-step task execution and self-correction without human prompts.
